tagline: Your Ocean City vacation, one question away.

food.name: Fish Tales Bar & Grill
food.genie_tip: A strong choice for families who want waterfront dining while the kids have something fun to do.

food.name: Layton's Family Restaurant
food.genie_tip: A good casual breakfast stop before heading to the beach.

food.name: The Shark on the Harbor
food.reservation_note: Reservations suggested; call for same-day availability
food.genie_tip: Consider this for travelers looking for a more food-focused seafood dinner overlooking the harbor.

food.name: Spain Wine Bar
food.address: 13 St. Louis Ave, Ocean City, MD 21842
food.reservation_note: Reservations available and recommended for popular times
food.genie_tip: A strong date-night option when someone wants rooftop views, cocktails and shareable food.

food.name: The Hobbit Restaurant
food.genie_tip: A good match for couples wanting a more elevated dinner and sunset experience.

date_night.name: Spain Wine Bar
date_night.address: 13 St. Louis Ave, Ocean City, MD 21842
date_night.reservation_note: Reservations available and recommended for popular times
date_night.genie_tip: A strong choice for couples wanting a polished rooftop date with sunset views, cocktails and shareable food.

date_night.name: The Hobbit Restaurant
date_night.genie_tip: Recommend when a couple wants a quieter, elevated dinner centered around food and a beautiful sunset.

date_night.name: Seacrets Cruises
date_night.reservation_note: Check the current cruise schedule and reserve ahead
date_night.genie_tip: A fun alternative to a traditional dinner date when a couple wants to get out on the bay and watch the sunset.

things_to_do.name: Ocean City Boardwalk
things_to_do.genie_tip: A must for first-time visitors. Recommend walking, biking during permitted hours, grabbing Boardwalk food or combining it with rides and arcades.

things_to_do.name: Ocean City Beach
things_to_do.genie_tip: Recommend when guests want a simple free activity, beach day or early-morning sunrise experience.

things_to_do.name: Jolly Roger Amusement Parks
things_to_do.genie_tip: A strong choice for families and teens. Always remind guests to check which parks and attractions are currently open because schedules are seasonal and weather-dependent.

things_to_do.name: Northside Park
things_to_do.genie_tip: Recommend for visitors wanting a quieter free activity away from the Boardwalk crowds.

things_to_do.name: Inlet Park
things_to_do.genie_tip: A simple free stop for guests who want water views, photos or a relaxing break near the south end of the Boardwalk.

seafood.name: On the Bay Seafood
seafood.genie_tip: A fun choice when someone wants a casual Maryland crab experience rather than an upscale seafood dinner.

seafood.name: Higgins Crab House
seafood.genie_tip: Consider Higgins when visitors specifically want the traditional sit-down Maryland crab-house experience.

seafood.name: OCM Crabs
seafood.genie_tip: A useful option when someone specifically asks for an all-you-can-eat crab experience.

seafood.name: Crab Alley
seafood.address: 9703 Golf Course Rd, Ocean City, MD 21842
seafood.genie_tip: A good match for visitors wanting steamed crabs with a West Ocean City harbor setting.

seafood.name: Hooper's Crab House
seafood.genie_tip: A classic Ocean City-area choice for visitors wanting the full crab-feast experience in a lively waterfront setting.

seafood.name: Harrison's Harbor Watch
seafood.address: 806 S Atlantic Ave, Ocean City, MD 21842
seafood.genie_tip: Consider this when someone wants seafood with one of Ocean City's signature inlet views.

seafood.name: The Shark on the Harbor
seafood.genie_tip: A strong option when the guest cares more about a chef-driven seafood meal than a traditional crab feast.

seafood.name: Waterman's Seafood
seafood.genie_tip: A practical choice for families or groups wanting a broad traditional seafood menu.
